M6: Field Properties ▸ Options for every field type: text alignment, default value, scroll long text, rich text, password, file selection, spell check, comb of characters (with its rules); choice defaults, sort items (the list is reordered), custom text, multiple selection, commit immediately; check box / radio checked by default and radios in unison. Reset form restores defaults. form_set_props takes align, default and flags
M4/M1: Drag page thumbnails to reorder (selection or the grabbed page, insertion bar, one undo step); damaged files say they were repaired, and Document Properties ▸ Advanced lists the repairs

M11.1: PDF Optimizer: new optimize crate measures each image's effective resolution where pages draw it and resamples (bicubic) and recompresses (JPEG quality steps or ZIP) colour and grayscale images, soft masks with them, only when smaller; discards thumbnails, alternate images, tags and print settings; Flate for unencoded streams. Reduce File Size now downsamples like Acrobat (150 ppi above 225, JPEG medium); Optimize PDF dialog (Images, Discard Objects, Discard User Data, Clean Up) composes Remove Hidden Information; doc_optimize tool (84 tools)

M9 perf: signature revalidation after edits reuses the signed ranges' digests and the parsed signed revision (DigestCache per document) and no longer scans the file for revision markers: a comment edit on a 120 MB signed file takes 6 ms instead of 84 ms; cos exposes xref entries so unchanged objects are skipped when diffing revisions
M9: Roadmap and status (≈ 26%)
M9.6: --dialog sign|certify opens Sign with a Digital ID (headless screenshots, control channel)

M9.6: Use a certificate in the app: Digitally sign / Certify (draw a rectangle, or click an empty signature field) and Certify (invisible); Sign with a Digital ID, Configure New Digital ID (create a self-signed ID or use a .p12/.pfx) and Sign as dialogs with appearance preview, reason, location and certification permissions; signing saves; Signatures panel (status, details, trust, view signed version, export certificate); signature message bar; digital IDs and trusted certificates persist. Fix: locate signature placeholders by their unique ByteRange marker (full saves renumber objects)

M9.5: Signatures in the engine and for agents: every document carries its validated signature fields (revalidated on edits and against the session's trusted certificates); Session::sign/mark_signed (signing saves; history before signing is dropped); full rewrites of signed documents are refused; certificates load from PEM/DER; sign_list, sign_id_create, sign_document and sign_trust tools (83 tools)

M9.1–M9.3: new sign crate: DER, X.509, CMS SignedData, PKCS #12 (PBES2 and legacy, MAC) on RustCrypto with aws-lc-rs for RSA private keys; PAdES B-B signing (new or existing field, visible or invisible, DocMDP certification) with an incremental placeholder save; validation (digest, signature, chain against a trust store, changes after signing classified under DocMDP); checked against pdfsig and OpenSSL
M5/M10: Comments panel filters by colour (named swatches) and checkmark; Create PDF from clipboard (image at its size, or text)

M5: Polygon, Connected lines, Cloud (cloudy border appearance), Callout (leader line with arrow, /RD text box, resize re-attaches the leader) and Insert text (caret) comments: annot shapes and appearances, click-to-place-points and drag-to-callout tools in the Comment/Highlight/Draw flyouts, /IT carried to the comment list (Callout, Cloud labels), comment_add types polygon/cloud/polyline/callout/caret
